title: Puharich's prosthetic finger with an ELF chip
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Puharich's prosthetic finger with an ELF chip, about 1970s at an unknown place, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: An unnamed guest researcher on the podcast of host Jesse Michels says that Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode ties to the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, described in his own words inventing an artificial finger in the 1970s. The guest says the finger held a chip that gave off a set ELF signal, meaning extremely low frequency radio waves, which if true would show Puharich building devices that work on the body with radio waves.
